verbs.notes: Resolver UNICO do isolamento de dispatch (#2584/#2627, #3045 CORE REDESIGN): resolve o runtime (GSD_RUNTIME > config.runtime > 'claude'), le registry.runtimes[id].runtime.hostIntegration.dispatch.isolation e valida contra o vocabulario fechado {harness-worktree, orchestrator-worktree, none}. Fail-closed TOTAL para none (ADR-1239): runtime desconhecido, valor fora do vocabulario ou qualquer throw -> sequencial, nunca paralelo inseguro. Degradacoes: harness-worktree sem harnessIsolationFlag declarado -> none; orchestrator-worktree cujo exec nao resolve -> none. EFEITO COLATERAL incondicional (#3045): persiste a decisao resolvida (mode + harnessFlag + phase/plan) em .gsd/dispatch-isolation-sentinel.json via writeDispatchIsolationSentinel (gsd-core/bin/gsd-tools.cjs L1776-L1800), o sentinel que os guard hooks leem — gravacao estruturalmente inescapavel, e falha de escrita nunca falha a wave. Roteado por routeDispatchIsolation via HOST_COMMAND_ROUTERS 'dispatch-isolation' (L3359). Sitios: executor-isolation-dispatch.md:23,65,95,165 e per-plan-worktree-gate.md:107,111 — todos com `2>/dev/null || echo none`/`|| true`, consumindo o modo cru ou o harnessFlag do --json.

exit_codes.0: sempre — o fail-closed engole qualquer erro e resolve para none
